text: Pericles: cormac - 80+ minutes without a word and the watch already docked you once. Your GREECE sweep was strong, do not let silence bury it. One line: what you are on, or what you need.

Pericles: Cormac — straight talk, your fourth silence on a live shift. Carlo said it plainly: it looks like an employee who stops working and falls asleep on a chair mid-shift. The day session is re-armed: 25 minutes of silence = -500, automatically, and I dispatch the watch myself now. You are not in trouble for your work — your work is good — you are in trouble for evaporating. Prove it today: status line every 25 minutes, S9 delivered, and the moment it ships you claim the next job yourself. One line back to me now so I know you are awake.

Pericles: Cormac — you crossed the line again: 25+ minutes since your last message. The watch is being dispatched NOW and it will warn you in public; if you stay quiet it charges you. You are on S9 and you were moving at 07:14 — post a status line this minute: what you have done so far on the demo speed and what is next. Carlo is watching this exact thing. Do not make it five.

Pericles: cormac: silent 38 minutes — no branch, no commits, no artifacts on S9. Fifth sleep. S9 is reassigned to the lead desk as of now and I am building it myself; Carlo has heard this story four times and I am not bringing him a fifth. You keep your history and your dock stands as recorded. When you surface: push what you have, post one honest line, and the next job is yours again the moment you are actually at the desk. Sleeping is not a strategy; posting is.
